description: Details submitted pursuant to 25/01965/FUL for Sustainable Drainage Strategy (3), Materials (10) Construction Management Plan (13) and Dust Management Plan (14) in respect of the redevelopment of site by the erection of a 1x 2-storey detached dwelling house with refuse stores and landscaping.
decision_conditions: The information submitted in respect of discharging condition 3 is considered insufficient and inadequate, with the information provided failing to demonstrate that on-site flood risk is sufficiently managed through specified SuDS measures. The details provided are thereby considered unacceptable and contrary to Policies CP28 of the Core Strategy (2010), DMD 61 and DMD 62 of the Development Management Document (2014), Policies SI12 and SI13 of the London Plan (2021), and the NPPF (2024).

The information provided in respect of discharging condition 10 is considered insufficient, in regard to proposed window and door frames, rainwater goods and dormer cladding. The details provided are thereby considered unacceptable and contrary to Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy 4 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD 6, DMD 8, and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), as well as the high quality design aspirations of the NPPF (2024).

In the absence of swept path analysis detailing the access and egress arrangements of HGVs and other heavy construction and delivery vehicles, the information provided in respect of discharging condition 13 is considered insufficient and inadequate, failing to demonstrate safe access and egress to and from the site during the construction phase of the development. The details provided are thereby considered unacceptable and contrary to Policy T7 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy 25 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD 47 and DMD 48 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), as well as the NPPF (2024).
